subject: Medford Farmers Market
overview: Medford Bytes hosted Medford Farmers Market board president Heather Meeker-Green and market manager Jane Hamill to discuss the upcoming market season at the Condon Shell. The conversation covered market vendors, volunteer opportunities, and food assistance programs.

items.title: Host Opening Remarks
items.summary: Danielle Balocca highlights ongoing city budget discussions and introduces the episode's interview with Medford Farmers Market organizers.

items.title: Introductions and Local Food Favorites
items.summary: Board president Heather Meeker-Green and market manager Jane Hamill introduce themselves and discuss their favorite local eateries in Medford.

items.title: Market History and Offerings
items.summary: Meeker-Green and Hamill recount the market's 16-year history, its current location at the Condon Shell, and its mix of produce vendors, local businesses, and grant-funded live performances.

items.title: Food Access and SNAP Matching
items.summary: Meeker-Green outlines accessibility initiatives, including a SNAP EBT match of up to $30 per week and a planned reduced-price produce delivery program for seniors.

items.title: 2022 Schedule and Community Involvement
items.summary: Organizers announce the market schedule running Thursdays from June 9 through October 13, a planned Thanksgiving market, and ways for community members, performers, and volunteers to participate.

items.title: Market Communications and Outro
items.summary: Hamill and Meeker-Green direct listeners to the market's weekly newsletter and email for vendor updates and contact information before the host closes the episode.
